costs.scope: Local training process only; no paid jobs or teacher calls. Dataset generation costs and sunk hardware/electricity are excluded.

limitations: Fresh-process checkpoint reload is a separate lead-owned step
seed_policy: Python random + torch CPU + MPS when selected; not a guarantee of bitwise deterministic MPS kernels

base_model.baseline: pretrained backbone with retained pretrained ranking head

validation_before.interpretation: Agreement with supplied targets; teacher labels are not independent correctness. No calibration claim.

validation_after.interpretation: Agreement with supplied targets; teacher labels are not independent correctness. No calibration claim.

weights.hash_format: sha256 of canonical contiguous CPU tensor torch.save serialization

runtime.elapsed_scope: through both checkpoint saves, before run.json write

memory.cpu_max_rss_scope: process lifetime high-water RSS; not accelerator peak
